name: images
note: IMG covers three alt spellings (a real string, an explicit null and a null metadata object — Jinja renders those as the string, `None` and the empty string), a caption that only exists when text does, an OUTSET_ROW run that swallows its OUTSET_ROW_CONTINUE neighbours and never emits their captions, and the FULL_WIDTH layout that is skipped with a warning. Note that an IMG *omitting* the metadata key cannot be tested here: the legacy reads it with paragraph["metadata"] rather than .get at core.py:291, so an in-window IMG without it raises KeyError and kills the whole parse. The IR defaults it to None instead (§3.3), so that payload renders here but not in the legacy.
